name: Neutral Moresnet (1816–1920)
description: A horizontal tricolor of black, white and blue.
history: Flag associated with Neutral Moresnet, the tiny zinc-mining condominium jointly administered by the Netherlands (later Belgium) and Prussia from 1816, absorbed by Belgium in 1920. Esperantists once proposed it as the world's first Esperanto state, 'Amikejo'.
